title: GALC Quality Assurance Initiative on the Treatment of Liver Cancer and Biliary Tract Cancer in Germany 2024
summary: The aim is to record the diagnosis and treatment of patients with hepatocellular carcinoma and biliary tract tumors in order to monitor the implementation of treatment recommendations in everyday clinical practice.
conditions: Malignant neoplasm of liver and intrahepatic bile ducts

interventions.name: No study-related examinations or surveys are carried out. Routine clinical practice is recorded retrospectively and the degree of adherence to guidelines is determined.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Diagnosis (initial, recurrence or progress) of hepatocellular cancer (Q3/Q4 2024) 
Diagnosis (initial, recurrence or progress) of biliary tract cancer  (Q3/Q4 2024)
Exclusion criteria:
Patients with a follow-up time of less than 8 weeks after diagnosis will be excluded (unless they have died within those 8 weeks).
